# Trapped Into Architecture (TI2A)

> The premier career platform and verified job board dedicated exclusively to Architecture, Interior Design, Architectural Drafting, and Studio Hiring in India.

## About
Trapped Into Architecture (https://trappedintoarchitecture.com) connects qualified architects, interior designers, 3D visualizers, landscape architects, and architectural draftspersons with top architecture studios and firms across India.

## Key Offerings & Directory
- Architecture Jobs: https://trappedintoarchitecture.com/jobs
- Architecture Internships: https://trappedintoarchitecture.com/internships
- Architecture Firms & Studios Directory: https://trappedintoarchitecture.com/companies
- Post a Job (For Employers & Studios): https://trappedintoarchitecture.com/post-a-job

## Major Role Categories (Clubbed & Normalized)
- Architectural Drafts Person: Covers Draftsperson, Draftsman, Draftsmen, Draftswoman, Draftswomen, Draughtsman, 2D Draftsman, CAD Draftsman
- Junior Architect: Covers Entry-level Architect, Assistant Architect, Fresher Architect, Jr. Architect, Graduate Architect
- Senior Architect: Covers Project Architect, Lead Architect, Principal Architect, Associate Architect
- Interior Designer: Covers Interior Architect, Interior Decorator, Commercial/Residential Interior Designer
- Junior Interior Designer: Entry-level and fresher interior design roles
- Senior Interior Designer: Senior & lead interior design roles
- 3D Visualizer: Covers 3D Visualiser, 3D Modeller, Architectural CGI Artist, Render Specialist
- Site Engineer & Site Supervisor: Covers Architectural Site Supervisor, Site Engineer, Project Site Coordinator
